title: Recap: -val/-vel and -ként for Seats and Roles

sections.title: Expressing Administrative Status and Institutional Seats
sections.content: You know *-val/-vel* from A1 Unit 28 and *-ként* ('as') from A2 Unit 36. History texts use them to say what a town or an office was: *Pozsony székhellyel működött* ('it worked with Pozsony as its seat'), *központként* ('as a centre'), *helyetteseként* ('as a deputy'). The table lists this lesson's new words and phrases.

sections.title: This lesson's words and phrases
rows: Royal Hungary: the northern and western part, ruled by the Habsburg kings
the diet that met in Pozsony

items.spanish: A Királyi Magyarország Pozsony székhellyel működött, mint a Habsburg-kormányzat központja.
items.english: Royal Hungary operated with Pozsony as its seat, as the centre of the Habsburg administration.

items.spanish: A magyar rendi gyűlések színhelyeként Pozsony a politikai élet központjává vált.
items.english: As the venue for Hungarian diets of estates, Pozsony became the centre of political life.

items.spanish: A nádor a király helyetteseként állt az országgyűlés élén.
items.english: As the king's deputy, the palatine stood at the head of the diet.
